title: Two new models for video and long-context text
summary:
Two new models, stateless Responses support, Open WebUI tools, and a more capable Polli made for a busy day.

MiniMax H3 Max Turbo was added for text-to-video and first/last-frame image-to-video, with synchronized audio and 5-, 10-, or 15-second outputs. GPT-6 Astra was added for text generation with tools, reasoning, up to 10 reference images, and a 1,050,000-token context window.

The API gained stateless POST /v1/responses support for eligible text models, community endpoints, and managed agents, including streaming and tool handling where supported. Managed agents now run through Gen and ignore caller-provided tools rather than rejecting the whole chat request.

Open WebUI gained Pollinations MCP tools using each signed-in user's key, and Enter can open eligible models there with the model preselected. A follow-up stopped Open WebUI from attaching built-in tools to every chat request. The community catalog also added Pollin Uptime and Nectar MCP.

highlights.title: MiniMax H3 Max Turbo
highlights.text: Generate 5-, 10-, or 15-second videos from text or first and last frames, with synchronized audio, using `minimax/minimax-h3-max-turbo`. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=minimax/minimax-h3-max-turbo).

highlights.title: GPT-6 Astra
highlights.text: Use `openai/gpt-6-astra` for text generation with tools, reasoning, up to 10 reference images, and a 1,050,000-token context window. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=openai/gpt-6-astra).

highlights.title: Stateless Responses API
highlights.text: Call `POST /v1/responses` with `store: false` on supported text models and managed agents. The stateless API supports streaming, with model capabilities listed in discovery. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Pollinations tools in Open WebUI
highlights.text: Use Pollinations MCP tools in Open WebUI with your own key, or open an eligible model from Enter with its ID already selected. MCP tools remain opt-in for each chat. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Stream chats with Polli
highlights.text: Polli now offers OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses endpoints that can stream replies and caller-facing function calls.

highlights.title: Polli renders diagrams
highlights.text: Polli can attach rendered Mermaid diagrams as PNGs in Discord replies, alongside charts and paginated tables.

highlights.title: First key, automatic Pollen
highlights.text: Create your first API key through the dashboard or BYOP flow, and the 0.25-Pollen first-key Quest reward is claimed automatically. Other earned Quests still need a manual claim. [Create an API key](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).
